name: std-tag-taxonomy
description: std-tag-taxonomy — hierarchical category tag tree (parent/child). TagBrowse fetches root-level Tag rows (parentId = "") on INIT and renders the active level via data-grid; SELECT_TAG drills into the chosen tag's children by fetching rows whose parentId matches it, binding @entity.id to that parent so the level is remembered; SHOW_ROOT resets back to the root level, surfaced as a back affordance while drilled in. Flat taxonomies (all parentId "") render exactly one level, unchanged. TagSelected is emitted on selection for consumers to filter content by tag.
